skill.name: turbo-doctor
skill.description: Diagnose and fix broken Goldsky Turbo pipelines interactively. Triggers on: pipeline in error state, stuck starting, connection refused, not getting data, duplicate rows, missing fields, slow backfill, or any named pipeline misbehaving. Runs logs/status commands, identifies root cause, and offers fixes. For CLI syntax or error pattern lookup without an active problem, use /turbo-operations instead.
skill.summary: Diagnose existing Goldsky Turbo pipelines using status, logs, and secret checks, then propose repairs that require user confirmation.
skill.author: goldsky-io

security_audit.summary: All 23 static findings are false positives: Markdown formatting, routine diagnostics, or repair commands explicitly gated by user confirmation. Destructive actions require approval, and credential guidance avoids inline values and disclosure in conversation. No evidence found of prompt injection, unauthorized exfiltration, or malicious reconnaissance in the reviewed files.

content.value_statement: Goldsky Turbo pipeline failures can interrupt data delivery and require careful investigation. This skill guides status checks, log analysis, and repair recommendations with confirmation before changes.
actual_capabilities: Check Goldsky authentication and identify the affected existing pipeline.
Interpret running, paused, error, starting, and completed pipeline states.
Inspect recent logs for connection, schema, resource, data, and configuration errors.
Check required secret availability when connection or authentication errors occur.
Produce a diagnosis with root cause, evidence, recommended fixes, and prevention advice.
Offer confirmed repairs through CLI commands, or provide commands for users without Bash access.
limitations: Direct execution requires Bash access, an available Goldsky CLI, and authenticated access to the relevant project.
New pipeline creation and standalone command-reference requests belong to other skills.
Related skills provide additional error patterns, authentication guidance, and configuration details.
CLI evidence may be insufficient for a diagnosis, requiring more information or Goldsky support.

use_cases.title: Investigate Interrupted Data Delivery
use_cases.description: Inspect status and recent logs for an existing pipeline that stopped delivering records, then review the proposed repair.

use_cases.title: Triage Pipeline Incidents
use_cases.description: Investigate pipelines in error or prolonged starting states and gather evidence before approving operational changes.

use_cases.title: Diagnose Through Shared Command Output
use_cases.description: Follow reference-mode diagnostic commands and share sanitized results when the assistant cannot access a shell.

prompt_templates.title: Check a Failing Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: My existing Goldsky Turbo pipeline [name] is in error state. Check its status and recent logs, explain the evidence, and ask before changes.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: investigate a named pipeline failure.

prompt_templates.title: Investigate Missing Data
prompt_templates.prompt: Pipeline [name] is running, but expected records are missing. Inspect recent logs and compare expected behavior with observed results. Do not change anything yet.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: investigate data delivery problems without immediate mutations.

prompt_templates.title: Work Without Shell Access
prompt_templates.prompt: Use reference mode to diagnose pipeline [name], which has connection errors. Give me diagnostic commands and analyze the sanitized outputs I provide.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Job-Mode Recovery
prompt_templates.prompt: Diagnose failed job-mode pipeline [name] using status, logs, and available YAML. Explain recovery risks and request explicit confirmation before deletion or redeployment.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: evaluate recovery for a pipeline that cannot restart or resume.

output_examples.input: Illustrative scenario: my pipeline is paused and no new records are arriving.
output: Issue: Data delivery is interrupted while the pipeline is paused.
Evidence: The supplied pipeline listing reports a paused state.
Recommended fix: Confirm the pipeline is not job-mode and ask whether to resume it.
Prevention: Check pipeline status after planned maintenance.

output_examples.input: Illustrative scenario: my pipeline reports authentication errors, and its referenced secret is absent from the secret listing.
output: Issue: The pipeline cannot authenticate to its destination.
Likely cause: The required secret is missing, based on the supplied configuration and secret listing.
Recommended fix: Confirm credential creation and enter the value through the CLI prompt.
Verification: Recheck status and logs after the approved repair.
Prevention: Verify required secrets exist before deployment.

best_practices: Confirm the current project and target pipeline before diagnosing or approving changes.
Use recent status and log evidence, and redact credentials before sharing diagnostic output.
Review destructive repair risks and explicitly approve changes before execution.
anti_patterns: Requesting a new pipeline or a standalone CLI reference instead of diagnosing an existing problem.
Clearing state or deleting a pipeline without reviewing impact and confirming the action.
Pasting secret values into chat or passing credentials inline in shell commands.

faq.question: Which problems does this skill investigate?
faq.answer: It investigates existing pipeline failures, prolonged startup, missing data, connection errors, schema mismatches, resource errors, and unexpected behavior.

faq.question: Can it work without shell access?
faq.answer: Yes. Reference mode provides commands for you to run and analyzes the outputs you share.

faq.question: Does it make changes automatically?
faq.answer: It can run diagnostic commands when Bash is available. It must request confirmation before changing pipelines or secrets.

faq.question: How does it handle credentials?
faq.answer: It checks required secret availability and recommends interactive CLI entry. It prohibits inline credential values and repeating revealed secrets in conversation.

faq.question: Can it restart job-mode pipelines?
faq.answer: No. The workflow states that job-mode pipelines cannot pause, resume, or restart. Recovery may require confirmed deletion and redeployment.

faq.question: Does it build new pipelines?
faq.answer: No. It directs new pipeline requests to turbo-builder and standalone command-reference requests to turbo-operations.
